classification_evidence.rationale: The communication names AI and AI-based systems as industrial drivers, proposes AI/autonomous-system platforms, investment and regulatory work.
Sections 2 and 4 centre on industrial digitisation, intelligent machines and manufacturing platforms.
Section 4.2 commits Horizon 2020 investment and coordinated R&D for AI/robotics-related technologies.
The heading and EUR-Lex metadata identify the European Commission and DG CNECT.
